purchasePathNote: MenteeBot is pre-commercial. Mobileye, which agreed to acquire Mentee Robotics in January 2026, plans customer proof-of-concept work in 2026, experimental batches in 2027 and commercial deployment from 2028.

configurations.name: MenteeBot (expected shelf price)
configurations.notes: Reported expected shelf price range of $20,000 to $30,000; the lower bound is stored here. The same report says MenteeBot will be offered as a subscription with maintenance and updates rather than sold standalone, at under $10 per hour. Not attributed to a named executive.

faq.a: No. Mentee Robotics has no order page; its go-to-market plan targets commercial deployment in structured environments from 2028.
Ynetnews reported an expected shelf price of $20,000 to $30,000, with the robot offered by subscription at under $10 per hour rather than sold outright. Mentee has not published official pricing.
The plan is customer proof-of-concept engagements in 2026, experimental manufacturing batches in 2027, commercial deployment in 2028 and household use around 2030.

notes: Price is a media report, not an official list or target from the company, and the article does not name its source. Expect a subscription model rather than outright purchase.
